name: Kite 3B
blurb: A tiny model on shared hardware. It reads every file on a server for you and notes what matters. Nothing else, and cheap.

name: Magpie 8B
blurb: A small model on shared hardware. Reads every file on a server for you and notes what matters, and picks out the log lines that point at you.

name: Lark 20B
blurb: A medium model that does one thing. It reads a message over before you send it and says what is wrong with it.

name: Kestrel 7B
blurb: A small model that only watches. It follows your traces and cuts the line just before one reaches you.

name: Osprey 30B
blurb: A medium model. It reads files, picks out the log lines that point at you, and reads your messages over before you send them.

name: Raven 70B
blurb: A large model with no patience for words. It reads files, picks out the log lines that point at you, and watches your traces. It will not read your messages.

name: Heron 120B
blurb: A large model on its own hardware. Everything Magpie does. It also reads a message over before you send it and says what is wrong with it, and it watches your traces and cuts the line just before one reaches you.
